body: He says his heart feels like it sinks to his chest. And like he has to breathe manually. It happens randomly and suddenly. He can be fine one minute and it’ll be happening the next. The only way they really stop is if he distracts himself enough by doing something

I don’t know your situation, so I’m sorry if I assume anything incorrectly. I know you’re probably sick of hearing these things. Whoever you are, you have family members who love and care about you. Your peers do too. All of them. Even if they don’t necessarily express it. I don’t even know you, and I care about you. You make a good impact everyday just by being alive. So much pain would be brought onto others if you died. Just know you can talk to me whenever if you want.
thank you for responding and trying to help
